categories.name: utils
categories.evidence: Modifies `BufferedWriter` in `src/streams.h` to avoid retrying failed flushes.
categories.rationale: Prevents stream write failures from throwing exceptions during destructor unwinding. The change resets `BufferedWriter`'s internal state so failed flushes do not re-trigger exceptions inside destructors.

categories.name: validation
categories.evidence: Changes block and undo file writing in `src/node/blockstorage.cpp`.
categories.rationale: Ensures storage write errors trigger normal error handling rather than crashing the node with `SIGABRT`. Explicitly flushing `BufferedWriter` before destruction allows out-of-space disk errors during block or undo writes to exit cleanly instead of aborting via `std::terminate`.
